notes.title: August Round-Up! 🗺️
notes.content: [h3][b]Hi Seedlings! [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]I hope everyone had a great summer! These past few months have been incredibly for us with game developement. With the new areas coming together nicely, we figured this monthly round-up is a good time to give everyone an early preview![/p][p][/p][h2]New Areas![/h2][p]ICYMI, last month we’ve shared some blurred teasers of our new maps, and this time we are excited to show them in full HD. (We’d have loved to do it in 4K but alas, upload size limit…)[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/fcdecfbace67be3250a26895f4fce5f3574d73dc.png"][/img][/p][p]The Brazen Plains is a vast open area surrounded by mountains. Numerous creatures roam the plains, and the surrounding mountains have all the nooks and crannies (and a MASSIVE lake) for you to explore.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/3cf5009614014008af8eeb00eab15006ad80c3d3.png"][/img][/p][p]The Volcano is a blazing inferno filled with environmental hazards and dangerous creatures. Mind your steps, and don't step on the lava![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/089601068f03033177538271d895ceee23b23bf5.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s another new area not included in last month’s screenshots – the Scrapshire Village. Populated by quirky characters (you might spot some speech bubbles in the backdrop), you can take on many fun challenges for bountiful rewards![/p][p] [/p][p]Aside from the maps, we’ve been working on new body parts for the full game. Below is a screenshot of some of them combined on a single creature. What creatures do you think they belong to? Take a guess, and we’ll talk about them in the next monthly blog![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/242ad3c1d88fbdf2106996b9a445a89b12bd664c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Community Creations[/h2][p]Before we go, let's check out what bizarre life forms our community made in the last month. We’ve received a number of awesome submissions from our Discord member Deathclawstudios. Here are some of their cool designs![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/b87473ebbb942248582d065e956ccf162b80a4b0.png"][/img][/p][p]This dragonfly has some impressive stats: over 200 stamina! That looks more than enough to soar across any map with ease![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/b36b007e87af1cb117bd6b15e7fededf2581aaf2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/85e16db5e4ecd64cd881a30a1be169a709299339.png"][/img][/carousel][p]They also recreated other IRL animals like a vulture and a fly with tools available in the demo. Look at the vulture spreading its massive wings![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/f39e1dbad1bc19049411e797844689434396e56a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]While this is all for this blog post, we'll be sharing more about the full game in the upcoming round-ups! Be sure to follow us on our socials and check back in next month![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://x.com/StrangeSeedGame" style="button" buttoncolor="#fd7aff"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@StrangeSeedgame" style="button" buttoncolor="#fd7aff"]YouTube[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@strangeseedgame?lang=en" style="button" buttoncolor="#fd7aff"]TikTok[/url] [/p]

tags.feature: The Brazen Plains is a vast open area surrounded by mountains. Numerous creatures roam the plains, and the surrounding mountains have all the nooks and crannies (and a MASSIVE lake) for you to explore.
The Volcano is a blazing inferno filled with environmental hazards and dangerous creatures. Mind your steps, and don't step on the lava!

Here’s another new area not included in last month’s screenshots – the Scrapshire Village. Populated by quirky characters (you might spot some speech bubbles in the backdrop), you can take on many fun challenges for bountiful rewards!

Aside from the maps, we’ve been working on new body parts for the full game. Below is a screenshot of some of them combined on a single creature. What creatures do you think they belong to? Take a guess, and we’ll talk about them in the next monthly blog!
This dragonfly has some impressive stats: over 200 stamina! That looks more than enough to soar across any map with ease!
They also recreated other IRL animals like a vulture and a fly with tools available in the demo. Look at the vulture spreading its massive wings!

notes.title: June Round-Up! 🍖
notes.content: [h3][b]Greetings seedlings! [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/0a67f9cbfe4d60c156ae6f1cfbccc253728cba8f.png"][/img]The July heat is coming in full swing. Our Pink Blob already took out its sunglasses to enjoy the summer beach. Our devs, though, decided to stay out of the scorching sun to work on the next batch of update instead. Here’s what we have for this monthly round-up!  [/p][p][/p][h2]More Visual Updates![/h2][p]You might have noticed our game looks a little different from before – that’s because we sneaked in another visual update in June! A couple highlights of the changes:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/59d589c19b8235b38e4765af0010943538e8a733.gif"][/img][/p][p]In the evolution panel, body part changes now trigger an animation to add more character and energy to our little Pink Blob (plus it is a nice visual indicator of body part changes).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/154357bad77e4cf8164acd339e4057093c0eb86f.png"][/img][/p][p]The nest UI now recolors depending on which area you are in, to give your nest a more thematic look.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/9029f2ad9ac19e818e51243817561a129dfad426.png"][/img][/p][p]There are also changes to visuals including particles and colors in the demo. You can see more details (and all our past updates) on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2463690/discussions/0/4633734719581723353/"]Steam update thread[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Canadian Games Sale[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/bf775e80aece0c648da127ec9454fef2d6f92b80.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Strange Seed will soon take part in the Canadian Games Sale! From July 1 to July 7, over 300 games from the land of maple, including us, will be on display! Check out all the promising upcoming games and exciting released titles [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45548675-Canadian-Games-Devs/sale/canadiansgamessale"]here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Community Creations[/h2][p]After covering all the monthly news, it’s time to share all the bizarre life forms designed by our creative community![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/f74bb79a8127096be88fb19b22e157f49caa0cea.png"][/img][/p][p]Our Discord member silly lil goober made a creature so fast it might have broken the chicken head part when it goes [i]zoom[/i] (But this is too funny so I think we’re just going to leave it. It’s a [strike]bug[/strike] feature.)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/df274f6d5efcb40985eb0094bf8be4b0aca125b8.jpg"][/img]A creepy creation by Gear. Why does it look like it has an explosive temper?[/p][p][/p][p]And that's all we've got for this monthly round-up! Join our [url="https://discord.gg/pJCxmhKM9B"]Discord server[/url] to talk about Strange Seed and share your own peculiar creature designs! Follow our [url="https://x.com/StrangeSeedGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@StrangeSeedgame"]YouTube[/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@strangeseedgame?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] for the latest news of Strange Seed![/p]

notes.title: May Round-Up! 🍖
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome back seedlings! [/b][/h3][p]
Have you noticed Strange Seed is a bit different from how it was two months ago? That's right, we've introduced multiple updates to the game over the last two months! Let's jump right in and see what's new!

[/p][h2]Sneaky Updates[/h2][p]Throughout April and May, we’ve been sneaking in an array of control optimizations, control bug fixes, new content and more to flesh out the demo! Here are a couple of highlights: 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/2c6e19cf9403acc3d503e12eb24f595651e702d4.png"][/img]Pink blob can now glide with beetle wings!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/b4e733a375cc91352aff0b680d38dc2630b1e27d.png"][/img]Certain NPCs now have tombstones, and some can be revived for a cost...[/p][p][/p][p]Scroll down to the bottom of this blog post for the full list of changes.  [/p][h2]Steam Events[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/76695c647df7141a4812bf21ad4e5880c707c287.png"][/img]You can also find our pink blob in multiple events in May. We started the month with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737-Indie-Assemble/sale/indieassemble"]Indie Assemble[/url], a global indie game festival organized by Excaliber. With 600 development studios participating, this event showcased over 1,000 released titles and upcoming games from May 5 to May 11.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/dacd886f59d65db12b9e2fbb5678dae019b7fe5c.png"][/img]We also collect creatures… with our bellies. Right after Indie Assemble, from May 12 to May 19, we took part in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/category/creature_collector"]Creature Collector Fest[/url] alongside many other titles that feature unique and bizarre creatures!

[/p][h2]Strange Creatures by Our Fans[/h2][p]Before we wrap up today’s blog post, let’s check out what peculiar life forms our community came up with during May!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/bbed958c4d72ce92fd2e234a7425f34fd703ec74.jpg"][/img]We don’t currently have frogs in the Strange Seed but that doesn’t seem to stop our players from making their own! Here is an attempt by Chonk to recreate the amphibian in the game. There’s even a tadpole stage being shared on the Discord channel!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/fe2c96e5c65a5ba934cab6eef53bff7ad03cbf75.png"][/img]This gentleman named Scrunkly is the creation of Grimluck the Golem. Not sure if this is intentional but the stag beetle mandibles do resemble a moustache, and pairs quite well with the hat.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/d2d09e53f0fdd4893c7d9c18cfc6f3c913ba0e80.jpg"][/img]And finally, we have the Wiggler from Chile Dawg, a creature that's 90% neck. If you don't want to drown, just evolve your neck longer than the water level.

If you're interested in sharing your own creature creations, join our [url="https://discord.gg/pJCxmhKM9B"]Discord server[/url]!

That's all for May. See you all next month, and follow us on [url="https://x.com/StrangeSeedGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@StrangeSeedgame"]YouTube[/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@strangeseedgame?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] for all the latest news (and memes) of Strange Seed!



[/p][h3]April 5 & April 10 updates:[/h3][list][*][p] Hey! Are you a murder hobo!? Well guess what, now you can kill EVERYTHING!
[/p][/*][*][p] ... as a result, a small number of previously unavailable creature parts can now be found
[/p][/*][*][p] Tombstones: some unique enemies leave a tombstone behind; few of these allow you to revive the enemy (for a price)
[/p][/*][*][p] Faster recovery after attacks, so now you can quickly use two separate attacks, or more easily attack then block
[/p][/*][*][p] More fixes to prevent compost balls from getting stuck on their way to the pit
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bug causing slow startup time for the game from Steam
[/p][/*][*][p] New / different sound when you die
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed missing Playstation controller icon in UIs
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed tombstone issues (not loading when they should, loading when they shouldn't)
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed jump animation not triggering sometimes
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a new Arms part for killing Rosa
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed the dark grey ground splotch that appeared after dying
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed the weird shimmer that appeared on objects sometimes (specular aliasing)
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed wings issues (t-posing during attack, giant size when using geoduck head)
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]May 12 & May 14 updates:[/h3][list][*][p] No more snake minigame in DNA recombination -- snake haters rejoice!
[/p][/*][*][p] ... but, DNA recombination can now lose Mystery Liquid (we'll add a new source of it soon)
[/p][/*][*][p] Glide ability added, for all fly/glide parts hold down jump to transition to gliding
[/p][/*][*][p] Base climb angle increased (so it's easier to climb now)
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved animation transitions during attacks
[/p][/*][*][p] Some graphical updates in various areas (hopefully improvements)
[/p][/*][*][p] Better camera tracking for fast-moving creatures (especially flying / falling ones)
[/p][/*][*][p] Better collider positioning for bipedal / vertical creatures
[/p][/*][*][p] Camera auto-zoom out for bigger creatures
[/p][/*][*][p] Geoduck neck no longer bumps everything and anything (but as a result, it will clip into walls freely)
[/p][/*][*][p] Updated transition animation when moving between scenes
[/p][/*][*][p] Drowning bar now depletes instead of fills
[/p][/*][*][p] Tombstone for Rosa now gives out her arms if you missed them
[/p][/*][*][p] Bug fix: player controls no longer lock up when using jump + attack while being attacked
[/p][/*][*][p] Bug fix: player controls no longer lock up when shooting ranged attacks into the void
[/p][/*][*][p] New creature shrine available somewhere in Honey Cliffs
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed sun in cliffs and beach passing through objects
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Rosa's tombstone position
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Rosa bossfight not doing any damage to player (oops)
[/p][/*][*][p] You can now murder the sweet, innocent race organizer
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: April Round-Up! 🍖
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello creature creators! [/b][/h3]

Welcome back to another monthly round-up for Strange Seed! It has been a busy month for us, joining different events and making new content. Here’s a quick summary of what happened over the past month!

[h2]April Events![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/3529bf71a988be54b1e4e151077c9114595ff547.png[/img]
Our little pink blob made an appearance in multiple events this month, starting with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/EarthAppreciationFestival2025]Earth Appreciation Festival[/url]. It is an event about our shared love and passion for our planet Earth, with games either highlighting the beauty of nature or the grim consequences if we neglect it. Strange Seed even got some screen time in the showcase video! You can see our segment on our YouTube, within it a little teaser of some future content!
https://youtu.be/NmHDWzeyuz8
We were also at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/londongamesfestival2025]London Games Festival[/url], where we got to display Strange Seed’s demo besides many other awesome games!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/72db49a9439b7d8a898654c0e36ff3e0d706c2f2.png[/img]

[h2]Cooking Up a New Feature?[/h2]
Recently we received some fun suggestions about making a chameleon in the game, so we decided to give it a go. Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1Oe6rjwGwWU ]YouTube short[/url] where Chris talks about how we managed to recreate the chameleon camouflage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/cf9761aa32467d3e6bfa7a3c64a0564529bf904b.png[/img]

[h2]Community Creations[/h2]
Just like last month, let’s have a quick look at what bizarre creations our community came up with on our [url=https://discord.gg/pJCxmhKM9B]Discord server[/url]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/4db06f447a6d9e9abb1a13991a63e4a3bf2b2b88.png[/img]
This first one is a submission from Thirdreverie. Floating in the air with the bright green arms and antlers, it almost looks like a new type of Pokemon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/4f6d1d29853d1908ffd2ed1566045a232d2879db.png[/img]
Next up we have Cynder’s creation. Seems like they have taken a liking in the hovering function, and decided to give this hovering creature a defensive conch too!


That’s everything for now! We wish everyone a great start to May and we’ll see you again next month! Be sure to follow us on [url=https://x.com/StrangeSeedGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@StrangeSeedgame]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@strangeseedgame?lang=en]TikTok[/url] for the latest updates!

tags.feature: Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1Oe6rjwGwWU ]YouTube short[/url] where Chris talks about how we managed to recreate the chameleon camouflage!

notes.title: January Round Up 🍖
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to the first monthly round up of 2025 for Strange Seed!

2025 is set to be an exciting year for Strange Seed and it's full speed ahead for the release of the full game later in the year. In the meantime however we will be keeping the demo up to date with the latest game improvements - the feedback from the demo is helping make Strange Seed the best version of Strange Seed so thank you and please keep the feedback rolling in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/86399d6553e68d515600d33f788aff8788945bc1.gif[/img]

The first demo update of the year just launched and it's quite a meaty one - here are the headliners:

[list]
[*] Four new creature shrines (starfish/conch, squirrel, devil's coach beetle, and axolotl)
[*] Dodge and block abilities on certain creature parts
[*] Save slots for creatures allowing you to swap outside a nest (after you pick up a special item)
[*] Creature bestiary showing what you've met and which parts you're missing
[*] New accessories menu with full customization of position, scale, rotation, etc
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255762/abc69dfe44c5becc59fde6240afbabe4758aa09a.png[/img]
Whose that [strike]Pokémon[/strike] creature!?

notes.title: Demo update: Nov 4, 2024
notes.content:
[b]Build update: November 4, 2024[/b]
[list]
[*]Added performance options: Low, Medium, High, Ultra
[*]Auto-set performance option when player starts (check the Video menu to select your own!)
[*]Split out Audio and Camera options to new submenus
[*]Large performance improvements in the forest
[*]New Stag Beetle Mother event in the Forest
[*]Plus, a better way to roll compost in the forest
[*]Significantly increased Stamina regen rate
[*]New music in beach area
[*]Changed combat music in tree interior and forest
[*]Replaced the widely disliked error and pickup sounds
[*]Control change in snake minigame: now uses mouse pointer instead of arrow keys (controller users are unchanged)
[*]Color improvements in snake minigame (colorblind people, let us know if it helped!)
[*]Changed Japanese font
[*]Fixed some Chinese / Japanese font issues
[/list]

The performance-related updates in this build were fairly massive, and there may still be issues in Low / Medium that we haven't found yet. 

In case you find anything or want to report on how well the performance options work for your computer, please join us over at the Discord: https://discord.gg/8JfYdQW23W

notes.title: Demo launch date: Sept 26
notes.content:
Our demo will be going live on September 26. Here’s a link to the demo page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224660/Strange_Seed_Demo/

We’ll be closing the playtest at the same time. In case you never got into the playtest — the demo is the same, but with more content and more bug fixes. I hope you’ll try it out, and give us any feedback!

[h3]Here is the list of major features added or changed since day 1 of the playtest:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Cliffs area with two quests
[*] Expansions to the Forest area
[*] Many changes to controls and camera
[*] Keybinds and video settings in main menu
[*] Creature part upgrade minigame
[*] Total revamp of attack indicators
[*] Destructible barriers and pushable buttons
[*] Player invincibility frames to prevent insta-deaths
[*] Rebalanced body parts and all enemies
[*] Polish effects like screen shake, water splashes, running trail, environmental sounds, dialogue typewriter, etc
[*] A boss that was pushover easy, then Dark Souls NG+ hard… hopefully now he’s at a good level
[*] Bug fixes… so many bug fixes 🫠
[/list]

[b]To everyone who has provided feedback so far, THANK YOU![/b] It makes a huge difference; we’re changing and improving things based on your notes every day.

In case you didn't spot our feedback button in-game, [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/11iUmELIaQ7dJk9sZRkssRfw16P3iSvdCT_0GdenYAFc/]you can access it here[/url]. Steam forum threads are also very welcome!

notes.title: Playtest signups are live!
notes.content:
Do you want exclusive, early access to the next big game? The upcoming hit of 2025?

Then look elsewhere! 😅 

But if you want to try out [b]an interesting, quirky RPG[/b], look for the button directly above this post that says “Request Access”. Then click it!

[h3]What’s in the Playtest[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]9 enemy types[/b] with [b]45 equippable parts[/b]
[*] [b]3 areas[/b]: the Caldera, the Ant Tree, and the Mushroom Forest
[*] [b]3 quests[/b] and [b]1 boss fight[/b] (or 2 if we can jam out the second)
[*] Various other features — try it and find out!
[/list]
[h3]Playtest, or wait for a demo?[/h3]
Your feedback will be an immense help to our development: [list]
[*] What was most or least fun
[*] Whether the difficulty level was low or high
[*] What [b]ideas YOU envision[/b] for what your creature can do
[*] And of course bug reports
[/list]
We’ve got a playtesting form linked in multiple locations through the game; it looks like this:

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2528290117000066661/DB74C129018DBD6F3DC674505C1F545F283C4577/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

Obviously, when we move on from the Playtest to the demo, the latter will be a bit more polished and have more content. If you’d prefer to wait for that, just make sure you’ve clicked the Follow Button at the top of the page!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2528290117000072758/D9E3ED2EA8C267FB749B337C4A7470C9779F120C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[h3]OK, so when will the Playtest be open?[/h3]
We’ll be letting in small groups of testers from [b]July 15 to July 30[/b]. If you request access, you’ll get to play within that date range.

Thanks so much for following our development! We’re trying to make the best, most interesting creature evolution RPG possible and every bit of feedback or encouragement is priceless.

notes.title: Early 2024 dev log: environments, quests and more!
notes.content:
We’re well into the phase where the game starts to feel pretty cohesive. Here’s our new “forest hallway” environment that I haven’t yet added to the Steam screenshots:

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2497884302569691828/EF323062127BD66F4B74CED396E22EAC4342E9F1/?imw=1024&imh=664&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true [/img]

Some of the tasks that went into making our new environments included:
[list]
[*] A fully featured lighting and shadow system
[*] New shaders for all vegetation and environment objects
[*] Completing the climbing system
[*] A bunch of new vegetation models made in Speedtree
[/list]
The challenge is getting these environments to work well on lower-end computers. 

I’m testing on my old Nvidia 1060 laptop and they’re stable at >30 FPS; I wonder if anyone with a lower end rig will be wanting to play? Luckily there is still some low-hanging fruit left for optimization.

[h3]The quest system[/h3]
The other major feature we’re working on polishing right now is a quest system. After some back and forth about how to code the quests, we settled on a pretty powerful system using a visual scripting system, via a 3rd party package. 

We've successfully put together a quest that involves grabbing a hat for the Queen Ant. Maybe you'll get to wear the hat afterward...?

Finally, a grab bag of other things we’ve been working on:
[list]
[*] Set up permanently flying creatures (like bees)
[*] Implemented a wrapper scene and sub-scene switcher that should both ease our workflow and make the game more stable
[*] Investigated and fixed various weird results from unexpected part combos
[*] Added a “treasure chest” feature tied to completing enemy encounters
[/list]
Is a demo ever coming? Well, the game is nearly ready for it! … but, we kept putting off final polish on the movement system. Early playtesting surfaced a few bugs in that area, so we’re spending time stomping those out before doing a fully public demo. 

I think we’ll be ready in a couple months (probably after Steam Next Fest, because releasing a demo in that time frame without being in the Fest is a bad idea). That said, if you want in on pre-public playtesting, DM me or join the Discord.

That’s all for today, thank you for reading and following Strange Seed!

notes.title: October dev log: combat lock-on, controllers, insects!
notes.content:
October was a very productive month for us! Strange Seed is beginning to feel very “playable”, even though there’s much work left to be done.

[h3]Combat lock-on[/h3]
Combat feels completely different with this change: locking-on to enemies. This includes an auto-rotate to attack and auto camera rotation while moving around.

[h3]New creatures: ant and bee[/h3]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2191624307495692711/350176CE2870EF3A72046E5C08CBC1C5C42E2C8E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img] 😀

[h3]Controllers (of all types!) enabled[/h3]
Pretty much everything should work now! I’m a controller-first guy and being able to constantly test Strange Seed using a controller is a huge, positive change for me.

… actually, I haven’t tried playing with a joystick or rhythm game accessory yet, so I can’t claim “everything” 😅 Let’s just say, any typical game controller.

[h3]Controller: ranged attack hold to aim[/h3]
Once we had the controller in, we realized that ranged attacks need a special control scheme when there’s no mouse. With a mouse, you just click wherever you want to attack. With the controller, hold L1 and move the joystick to position the landing zone. (This makes me want to play Valkyria Chronicles again…)

[h3]Final word[/h3]
Originally I thought we’d have a rough demo out by now, but the plan was to have very incomplete combat mechanics. When it came down to it, combat felt so central to the game that we needed to work on polishing it before the demo.

So that’s what we’re doing right now — in November, we’ll be running some private playtests of combat in greybox levels, ensuring that our attack timing, movement scheme, encounter design and so forth is really solid.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: September dev log: adding skin swapping
notes.content:
This month we added a material and color user interface. Every creature has its own skin, and now that skin can be applied to others and recolored. Here's a quick video:

[previewyoutube=RTE93i7wFLM;full][/previewyoutube]

… I have a personal compulsion to make everything neon, but normal colors work just fine too.

This was pretty complex to set up because of all the small details: tying into our evolve system; making decisions for sub-parts and special cases; and accounting for a variety of shaders. All that said, the feature was completed within the allotted time (there are still future improvements to make, of course).

Other things we completed this month:
[list]
[*] New creatures: tortoise and snake
[*] Performance testing and work within scenes to improve FPS for low-end devices
[*] Some dance animations (just for fun… for now)
[*] Continued improvements on AI movement via the NavMesh
[*] Started on ambient enviro sounds, bugfixes for existing creature sounds
[/list]
Headed into October, we’re working on controller implementation, combat polish, and some new environments. By the end of the month, we'll also revamp our Steam store page with a bunch of new assets -- exciting!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: August devlog: sloggin' the swamp
notes.content:
Happy Labor Day everyone! In August we began kicking the tires on some existing systems, making sure the foundation is solid going into the second half of developing Strange Seed.

Here are some of the major tasks we completed:
[list]
[*] New player/enemy creatures: pig and failed evolve slimes (enemy only)
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/laLBkie.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added NavMesh-based enemy AI / navigation and more AI behaviors
[*] Improved the look and timing of ranged and area attacks
[*] Exhaustively investigated various potential refactorings to our ground collision system
[*] Completely revised and replaced our evolution UI and HUD styling
[*] Studied performance: on most of our dev machines, the game runs at 60fps or well above that, but on a couple older laptops, it’s experiencing drops under 30fps; this appears to be mainly an issue with draw calls, which means it’s very solvable by offering alternate performance options for lower-end machines
[*] Evaluated and tested various occlusion and frustrum culling methods to get higher FPS across all devices
[/list]
Overall I’m pretty happy with the results of our refactoring and reevaluation of the core systems. In early August I found myself feeling semi-panicked about the quality of collisions in the game — not based so much on anything that was actually going wrong, but more on what might go wrong in the future. (Hey, I just get nervous sometimes, alright!?)

As a result, I got together with my engineer Felix and we evaluated a bunch of potential options. First, for the ground collisions, we considered replacing an existing torso-based system with a per-foot system, which would also change up how we did walk and run animations.

In the end we got together with our artist, Jhulian, and did a team evaluation of the old system versus the new idea. And as a group we decided… our existing system is actually the best option! This might sound like a story that goes nowhere (hah) but for me, it was a great moment; it means we’re on the right track.

We actually did end up changing the attack collision system, to use primitive colliders (mainly capsules and spheres) to register combat hits. That’s a fairly standard system for 3d games and for us, it worked perfectly from the first test.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zCRCEbm.png[/img]

As a last word, when I was writing this post I realized that a comic from a book on gamedev (by Matt Hackett) described this month perfectly:

[url=https://www.valadria.com/game-dev-comics-by-matt-hackett/][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FzrWUrSagAA_TvF?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img][/url]

We clearly spent August in the Slog Swamp — except for Jhulian, who spent half his time on Content Mountain. Our team has been working together for years now with various finished projects under our belts, so the Swamp isn’t nearly as uncomfortable as it used to be. It’s actually a fairly satisfying place, when you manage to make some progress.

See you next month!

notes.title: July development log: perfecting the creature
notes.content:
This month we made a ton of progress on the fine details of the creature system — including special poses like climbing, tweaking odd size and part combinations, fixing physics issues, and improving combat.

Going into August, we’ll continue making some improvements to the character rig and ground collision. Polishing these was initially planned for later; however, to ensure that we deliver a great demo, we’ve moved them up.

[h2]Finished in July:
[/h2][list]
[*] New creatures: geoduck and monkey (both ranged attackers)
[*] Special setup for ranged attacks: rules around attacking near / far, attacking slanted surfaces like cliffs, and projectile trails
[*] Switched up how we detect hits to be much more accurate
[*] Fixed wing rotation to avoid clipping through torso
[*] New attack VFX for all creatures (we switched from animations to a Trail Renderer)
[*] Allowed arms or legs to ragdoll if they can’t reach the ground… by the way, this is hilarious:
[*] Enemies: Fixed various navigation and behavior errors
[*] Enemies: No more insta-aggroing the entire zone, and reset properly on player death
[*] Enemies: Added combat music! Thanks to Donahue Industries for that.
[*] Player creature: Added a summed stats panel to the evolve UI
[*] Player creature: Fixed how some parts display in the UI
[*] Player creature: Drowning when underwater
[/list]

[h2]Coming up in August (partial list):[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updates to rig and collision (already mentioned above)
[*] Complete UI overhaul to replace our initial placeholders
[*] Nailing down combat stats for initial creatures and enemies
[*] Improving on ranged enemy attacks (melee comes first in this game, but ranged weapons do exist!)
[/list]

See you for the next update!
